text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san. The birthday present is good! 
I am happy. Feeling joyful. It was a yay!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad you liked it. The shawl 
with all the little animals on it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hattori Shinobimaru is on the 
shoulder, Shirayuki Pyonko-san is on the 
chest, and Chunmaru-san is right on the 
edge over here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whether at the park, in the mountains... 
or by the sea. Just being together makes 
me happy.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There's still a slight chill in the air 
these days. Please come out with me 
sometime soon.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right away. I'll be heading out 
immediately, so—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Flight-san, why don't you come with us?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With a shawl filled with everything I 
love, and with the person I love most. 
That is how I wish to go out.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then I must coordinate with a vibrant 
shawl and accompany you!
